title: Mutai, Hall make 115th Boston Marathon fastest in history (Abbott WMM)
claims: Geoffrey Mutai of Kenya won the 115th Boston Marathon (18 April 2011) in 2:03:02, which the Majors circuit release calls a new Boston course record.
The Boston course does not qualify for world records: it has a net elevation drop and a start-to-finish separation of 91%, which exceeds the 50% separation rule.
The 2011 women's open winner was Caroline Kilel of Kenya in 2:22:36, two seconds ahead of Desiree Davila of the United States.
